archiveTitle: Daily Brief | The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel: The Elder Scrolls VI Is Officially Titled Sentinel

entries.headline: Xbox Game Pass reveals its first November wave, with Warhammer Survivors joining day one on November 10
entries.summary: The first November wave includes Vampire Crawlers on November 4 across different membership tiers and Warhammer Survivors on November 10 for Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass. Warhammer Survivors supports cloud, Xbox Series X|S, handheld devices, and PC.
entries.verification: Opened Xbox Wire primary source; dates, membership tiers, and platforms are taken directly from the article.
entries.timeNote: Published at 02:00 Beijing time on November 4; individual availability dates follow the article.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI pre-load opens on PS5 on November 10 ahead of its November 19 launch
entries.summary: Players who pre-order can begin pre-loading at local midnight on November 10. PlayStation recommends clearing at least 212GB on PS5; the game launches on PS5 on November 19.
entries.verification: Opened PlayStation Blog primary source; pre-load timing, storage guidance, and the PS5 launch date come from the article.
entries.timeNote: Published at 07:28 Beijing time on November 4; pre-load begins at local midnight.

entries.headline: Helldivers 2 adds poisonous Terminids and expands bug cave networks
entries.summary: The update introduces the Noxious Scavenger and Noxious Spewer, whose attacks inflict poison, while Terminid cave networks spread to more biomes including deserts and tundras.
entries.verification: Opened PlayStation Blog primary source; enemy types, poison effects, and cave expansion come from the article.
entries.timeNote: Published at 05:02 Beijing time on November 4 and described as available that day.

entries.headline: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds begins Year Two with Duel Mode, new Gadgets, and more
entries.summary: Year Two adds Duel Mode, new characters, Gadgets, the Super Slot, and vehicles inspired by classic Sega consoles. The developers also discussed how those vehicles use the game's front-and-rear combination system.
entries.verification: Opened the PlayStation Blog developer interview; all named modes, systems, and vehicle details come from the article.
entries.timeNote: Published at 06:00 Beijing time on November 4 and described as launching that day.

entries.headline: Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas: Age of Wonders 4 expansion The Silver Seas launches with seafaring cities and new factions
entries.summary: The Silver Seas centers on ocean play, adding the Mercantile Culture for building cities at sea alongside the Cartel, Barony, Sharkkin, and Aqualon.
entries.verification: Opened the Xbox Wire first-party developer article; launch status and named systems come from the article.
entries.timeNote: Published at 22:00 Beijing time on November 3 and described as available that day.

entries.headline: The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel: The Elder Scrolls VI is officially titled Sentinel, with reports placing it five years after Skyrim
entries.summary: Bethesda's 40th-anniversary material revealed the name and logo for The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel. Two outlets report that it is set in Fourth Era 206, five years after Skyrim, and that the Sentinel name points toward Hammerfell.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Famitsu independently confirm the title; an Xbox Wire primary headline snapshot also confirms the official naming. The timeline and Hammerfell connection remain attributed to media reports.
entries.timeNote: The earliest included media report was published at 23:52 Beijing time on November 3.

entries.headline: Niftski sets a 4:54.299 Super Mario Bros. Any% world record
entries.summary: Niftski posted a 4:54.299 run on November 1, leaving the Super Mario Bros. Any% record only two frames behind the 4:54.265 tool-assisted theoretical best.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON reports the runner, category, real-time result, and theoretical mark. The packet does not include a first-party Speedrun.com record page, so this remains a media report.
entries.timeNote: The run took place on November 1; the report was published at 13:01 Beijing time on November 3.

entries.headline: Alinea estimates Bloodborne sold about 251,000 additional copies in 2026
entries.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates, as relayed by AUTOMATON, put 2026 sales at roughly 251,000 copies and lifetime sales at about 10.4 million. It also estimates around 500,000 players in October.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relays estimates from Alinea Analytics; every sales and player figure is presented as an estimate rather than official financial reporting.
entries.timeNote: Published at 10:49 Beijing time on November 3; figures are Alinea Analytics estimates.

entries.headline: Stardew Valley update 1.7 is planned for 2027 and may be the game's largest yet
entries.summary: Eric Barone said at the October 25 finale of the Symphony of Seasons tour that update 1.7 would be the game's largest. The report says it is planned for 2027 and that previously announced new marriage candidates are only part of the update.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relays Eric Barone's remarks at a public event. The 2027 window is the report's rendering of 'next year'; no exact date is available.
entries.timeNote: The remarks were made on October 25; the report was published at 09:50 Beijing time on November 4.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy Resonance high-resolution mod draws attention and criticism over lost pixel-art character
entries.summary: A mod that upscales the game's pixel characters has attracted attention on a mod site, while many social-media responses argue that it strips away the appeal of the original pixel art.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON reports the mod's changes, attention, and audience reaction. Dynamic popularity was not converted into a fixed ranking.
entries.timeNote: Published at 15:48 Beijing time on November 3.

entries.headline: 007 First Light gets a one-hour trial for select PlayStation Plus members
entries.summary: PlayStation Plus Premium or Deluxe members can access a one-hour trial covering the prologue and some training sections. The applicable tier varies by region.
entries.verification: IGN reports the duration, eligible membership tiers, and playable content. The packet does not include a first-party PlayStation Store trial page, so this remains a media report.
entries.timeNote: Published at 07:24 Beijing time on November 4; membership tier names vary by region.

entries.headline: itch.io adds generative-AI disclosure filters for search results
entries.summary: The new filters let users exclude or include projects based on whether they use AI and narrow results by where AI was used, including graphics, code, or tools.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON reports and quotes itch.io's feature announcement. The packet does not include the full first-party itch.io page, so this is published as a media relay of official information.
entries.timeNote: The feature launched on November 3; the report was published at 09:29 Beijing time on November 4.

entries.headline: Google adds a search Easter egg for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
entries.summary: Searching Google for "時のオカリナ" or "ゼルダの伝説" triggers an interactive Ocarina of Time-themed Easter egg. The report says several other Zelda subtitles do not trigger the same effect.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON identifies the search terms and resulting effect. The packet does not include a first-party Google announcement, so this remains a media report.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:50 Beijing time on November 3.
